# Jet Ski Miami 7

> Premium jet ski rentals in Miami Beach, Florida — from $149/hour.

## About
Jet Ski Miami 7 rents premium Yamaha and Sea-Doo jet skis in Miami Beach, FL.
We offer self-guided rentals and guided tours across Miami, Miami Beach, Aventura, and South Florida.

## Location
Miami Beach, FL (Stillwater Drive). Coordinates: 25.7907, -80.1300.

## Hours
Daily 7:00 AM – 7:30 PM, 7 days a week.

## Pricing
- Jet ski rental from $149/hour
- Group discounts for 3+ jet skis
- Fuel, life vests, safety briefing and full insurance included
- $150 refundable security deposit per jet ski (released ~5 business days after return)

## Fleet
Premium Yamaha and Sea-Doo jet skis (seat 2–3 riders) plus a 28ft Bennington pontoon boat.

## Contact
- Phone / WhatsApp: +1 (786) 863-1721

## Top FAQs
- How much? From $149/hour.
- License? Florida boater safety course required for anyone born on/after Jan 1, 1988 — we help arrange it.
- Minimum age? 18+ to rent, 14+ to operate (per Florida law).
- 2 riders per jet ski? Yes (2–3 riders).
- Self-guided or guided? Both are available.
- Beginners welcome? Yes — full safety briefing included.
